steps.title: Initial positions
steps.rule: Go to 7m south of the centre.

MainTank.rule: Go to 5m north of the centre.

OffTank.rule: Go to 5m north of the centre.

steps.title: Lineup next to omega M
steps.cue: A tether lands on another player
steps.rule: Read the strat's LineupNextToOmegaM: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: NewNorthA).

steps.title: Wave cannon spread
steps.rule: Read the strat's WaveCannonSpread: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: NewNorthA).

RegenHealer.rule: Read the strat's WaveCannonSpread: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: NewNorthB).

MeleeDpsA.rule: Read the strat's WaveCannonSpread: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: FirstMissing).

steps.title: Knockback pre position
steps.rule: Read the strat's KnockbackPrePosition: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: NewNorthA).

MeleeDpsA.rule: Depends on TowerNorthFlipped and SpinnerRotation: false & CounterClockwise → E 4m; true & CounterClockwise → S 4m; true & Clockwise → NW 4m; false & Clockwise → NW 4m.

MeleeDpsB.rule: Read the strat's KnockbackPrePosition: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: SpinnerRotation).

PhysRangedDps.rule: Read the strat's KnockbackPrePosition: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: NewNorthB).

steps.title: Tower positions
steps.rule: Read the strat's TowerPositions: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: NewNorthA).

OffTank.rule: Depends on TowerNorthFlipped and SpinnerRotation: false & CounterClockwise → SE wall; true & CounterClockwise → NE wall; true & Clockwise → NE wall; false & Clockwise → W wall.

MeleeDpsA.rule: Read the strat's TowerPositions: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: NewNorthB).

PhysRangedDps.rule: Read the strat's TowerPositions: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: SecondMissing).
